claim: OSF is an external free/open-source research project management and sharing platform that supports private collaboration and public dissemination across the research lifecycle.
future_grounding_route: OSF projects can seed acquisition only after public availability, file provenance, license, metadata, and biological relevance are verified.
project_use: Protocol, preprint, supplement, and dataset discovery route for MS-related projects.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Project-level files, protocols, materials, preprints, and datasets not always mirrored in specialist repositories.
why_unverifiable: OSF project contents are external and may be private, mutable, or heterogeneous; specific public records require project intake.
